systems.system: GESTDOC (Modernização e Reforço da Cadeia de Identificação e Segurança Documental em Cabo Verde e na Guiné-Bissau)
systems.owner: financed by the European Union, managed and co-financed by Camões, I.P.; Cabo Verde partners present were SNIAC, Imprensa Nacional, NOSi, DGRNI and the foreigners and borders directorate
systems.tiers: not stated for Cabo Verde; a project, closed 22-23 January 2025

note: The closing event of a two-country project. The civil registration system it launches (SIREC) and the mobile-registration vehicle are Guinea-Bissau's; for Cabo Verde the article names only the institutions that attended and states nothing about its registry.
